description:
FOUND s512p (Opus, 2026-10-08), the residue of #2723's reproducer after the end-anchored wrapper.  Tree = main 5adcc156 + #2723; single runs, load ~4 (another agent's leg), wall incl. ~0.175 s start-up:
  my %h; for my $i (1..30000) { $h{u} .= "line $i\n" }                                      0.19 s  (quiet-box bench, #2875)
  ... ; $m++ if substr($h{u}, -2, 1) eq "9"        (scratch/s512p/repsub.pl)                2.11 s   perl 0.11 s
  ... ; $m++ if $h{u} =~ /9\n\z/                   (rep2.pl, WITH #2723's tail-start scan)  2.53 s   perl 0.11 s
  the same match on a FIXED 320 KB string, 90 000 times (fixed.pl)                          0.29 s   (so the scan is no longer the cost)
SUSPECT: each READ of the growing in-place cell (the :strbuf box / the str-buffer slot) produces a fresh simple-string copy of the whole value (O(length) per read -> quadratic over the loop).  THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT: time repsub.pl with N = 15 000 / 30 000 / 60 000 (quadratic = x4 per doubling) and statprof one run: if the top frame is the buffer->string copy (subseq / %pcl-str-blit / coerce) the fix is a read path that hands the buffer's displaced/simple data without copying when the reader does not keep it (substr, =~, length, eq).  Worktree agent-ad4d28a21ff7f772a scratch/s512p has the programs.


=== DONE (s513c) ===
Discriminating measurement (base 33721af7): repsub at 15k/30k/60k = 0.58/1.79/8.48 s (x4.0, x5.1 net of start-up -- quadratic); statprof: sb-kernel:vector-subseq 68 % total (the :strbuf getter's whole-string snapshot).  Fix (runtime only): %p-live-text hands a :strbuf cell's buffer to readers that keep nothing -- p-substr's extraction (2-3 args) and a single m// without /g (do-regex-match's single-match arm became %p-single-match, called by the general arm and the live arm; it scans the buffer's data vector to the fill pointer and the match record keeps a DISPLACED view of that prefix, immutable because the buffer only grows).  An element reaches them as its slot box: %p-length-helem/-aelem became %p-peek-helem/-aelem, shared by compiler macros on p-length, p-substr and p-=~.  Hand-replaced A/B: repsub 1.88 -> 0.04 s, rep2 2.33 -> 0.04 s.  Bench accumread 1.507 -> 0.0103 s (perl 0.0035).  Guard Pl/t/perf-levers-11.t rows 7-10 (mechanism, timed, a 19-row answer table incl. a kept copy, $& after a later append, pos, s///, 4-arg substr, memfh).  NOT done (still #2722): :memfh cells, eq / index / print of the growing string, a /g match.  Commit a729ce8b.
subject: PERF: an append loop that also READS the growing string each iteration is quadratic -- `$h{u} .= "line $i\n"; substr($h{u},-2,1)` x30000 = 2.1 s (append alone 0.015 s, perl 0.11 s); the read materializes the whole :strbuf / str-buffer value each time
